scope: Join all13021 frozen development tasks against available complete pre-fix catalogs. No final2402 tasks, unselected siblings, queries, ranking, training or model selection. Preserve roles and full denominators.
acquisition_checkpoint: Wait for running experiment38 resume1 (maximum2000 new requests) to terminate normally. Run offline join and exact replay with unchanged caches before resuming acquisition. Pin resulting aggregate and private evidence SHA256. This is a partial availability checkpoint, not a smaller selected evaluation cohort.
integrity: Use existing bounded root and complete-catalog validation with a callback that never accesses network. Missing cache is a typed unavailable condition. Corrupt cache/schema/identity errors stop execution rather than being counted as unavailable. Verify fixed patch projection and membership using experiment39 readers. Deterministically hash normalized catalog and original root bytes for private per-task evidence.
matching: Binary-search sorted unique tree paths for every supported old-path label. Count regular blobs, symlink blobs, gitlinks, directory matches and missing paths separately. File-candidate coverage uses regular+symlink blob paths consistent with existing search evaluation; following symlink/submodule targets remains forbidden. Tasks with parse failures, unsupported blocks or no old paths cannot become complete target-coverage successes.
bounds: Reuse existing2MiB roots,32MiB stored catalogs,100000 entries/16MiB path bounds,256MiB streaming projection and2MiB patch limits. Retain one catalog at a time and compact per-task evidence. No process-global cache, parallel mutation or new locks.
validation: Synthetic missing-vs-corrupt cache behavior, exact snapshot paths, sorting/duplicates, regular/symlink/gitlink/directory distinctions, unusable labels, full cohort denominators. Actual offline replay and race outputs must match byte-for-byte. Full race/vet/format/redacted scans gate publication. Isolated resource measurement only after network collection and other checks have finished.
publication: Publish code, plans and role/repository aggregate counts only. Keep task IDs, paths, root bodies, detailed evidence and patches private. No licensing approval or model-release claim; no model/HF artifact in this step.
